item.title: [ZEPPELIN-4829] NPE in RemoteInterpreterServer#getStatus when interpreter is not opened yet
item.description:
I'm using zeppelin 0.9.0-preview1 + livy

When i use %livy.sql (or %sql because livy is my default interpreter) , i'm getting :

Or , when using scala code with livy , it's working 

 

the same livy configuration was working with zeppelin 0.8

i'm using cloudera 5.12 with livy 0.5 and spark 2.1

the only change was zeppelin version (from 0.8 to 0.9),
item.summary: NPE in RemoteInterpreterServer#getStatus when interpreter is not opened yet
